      Admission

      553:

      A candidate who has passed the Intermediate or equivalent examination, recognized by the University of Lucknow, is eligible for seeking admission to B.A. Sem–I or B.Com Sem-I.  Candidates seeking admission to M.A. Sem- I should have a graduation degree from a recognised university.
